date_line: SUNDAY, 22 NOVEMBER 2026  ·  ONE IMAGE, THE WHOLE DAY

hero.body: NATO chief Mark Rutte vowed on Saturday that the alliance will defend every inch of Polish territory, a day after two Russian missiles and a drone crashed in south-east Poland during Moscow's mass strike on Ukraine. Warsaw calls the incursion a deliberate provocation. NATO's council meets on Monday.
hero.headline: NATO WILL DEFEND EVERY INCH OF POLAND
hero.kicker: RUTTE IN WARSAW AFTER THE MISSILE LANDINGS

stories.body: Russian cargo ship Sparta II, bound for Kaliningrad, was hit by drones and caught fire in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday, drifting into Finnish waters. Finland imposed air and sea restrictions; Estonia will close all land borders with Russia from 1 December.
stories.headline: War spills into the Baltic Sea

stories.body: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said it shot down two US drones over the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday, and tankers were hit near Oman. Days earlier Iran struck a US air base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain.
stories.headline: Gulf war flares again

stories.body: Mexican forces captured FBI top-10 fugitive Fausto Isidro Meza Flores in Sinaloa overnight; the arrest set off gun battles, burning cars and 11 deaths. US intelligence helped track the Beltrán Leyva boss.
stories.headline: “El Chapo Isidro” captured

stories.body: A magnitude 6.9 earthquake struck central Peru on Friday evening, felt in Lima, sending residents into the streets. No casualties or damage were immediately reported; the epicentre lay 34 km north of Junín.
stories.headline: M6.9 quake shakes the Andes

stories.body: President Zelensky called Vladimir Putin a “killer” after Donald Trump described the Russian leader as a friend — as Russia's 500-weapon assault on Kyiv's bridges and power grid locked both sides into a new escalation cycle.
stories.headline: Zelensky: Putin is a “killer”

ticker: RUSSIA FIRED 400+ DRONES AND 110 MISSILES AT UKRAINE IN ONE NIGHT  ·  NATO COUNCIL MEETS MONDAY
